digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, author-facing documentation and guidance system
propositions: Authors must name risky runtime mechanisms and commit to a fast out-of-loop proof (local run or manual probe) before codifying them in a slow delivery loop.
The packaged plan guide must identify the new de-risk guidance as T15 and describe two permitted proof forms: local run or manual probe against the real target.
Throwaway experiment teardown must be scoped only to resources created by the experiment, not the broader environment.

The criterion registry vocabulary must be updated from 32 criteria / T1–T12 to the validated 44 criteria / T1–T15 across registry.py module docstring, criterion-pins.json, and plan-review-gate.md hand-authored overlay documentation.
